problem: Paid finalization was duplicated across verifyPayment (query path) and payCallback (async path): each independently marked the order paid, wrote a payment row, and granted entitlement with only read-then-write idempotency. No DB uniqueness; no provider-side amount/mchid/appid authority on the query path; concurrent verify+callback could double-grant; no crash recovery between 'order paid' and 'entitlement granted'.

changes.SHARED_FINALIZE_PATH: New canonical cloudfunctions/common/paymentFinalizer.js :: finalizePaidOrder() (synced byte-identical into verifyPayment/lib + payCallback/lib). BOTH verifyPayment and payCallback now converge on this single authoritative path — no duplicated entitlement-grant logic.
changes.PROVIDER_AUTHORITY: finalizePaidOrder accepts ONLY authenticated provider evidence. validateProviderEvidence enforces: trade_state==SUCCESS, transaction_id present + structurally valid, out_trade_no==local orderId, mchid==expected, appid==expected (when provider supplies it), amount.total==local authoritative order amount (exact), currency==CNY (when supplied). Any mismatch → fail-closed, no paid, no entitlement. Client claims (paid=true / amount / txn / SKU) are never trusted.
changes.EXACTLY_ONCE_GATES: G1 order terminal: orders.where({orderId, status in finalizable}).update → stats.updated===1 unique winner. G2 payment row: payments.transactionId UNIQUE index → at-most-one row; cross-order reuse → rejected + security audit. G3 entitlement: entitlement_grants.orderId UNIQUE index → at-most-one grant.
changes.CRASH_CONSISTENCY: Re-entry self-heals: order=paid but payment row/grant missing → restored (idempotent on re-entry); grant exists but order not paid → order re-claimed, grant not duplicated.
changes.CALLBACK_CONVERGENCE: payCallback business block (paid transition + payment row + grant) replaced by a finalizePaidOrder() call; duplicate callback → idempotent; rejected finalize → non-200 (fail-closed, never silent success).
changes.QUERY_ORDER_EVIDENCE: verifyPayment/lib/payment.js + createOrder/lib/payment.js queryOrder now surface authenticated provider fields (out_trade_no/mchid/appid/amount{total,currency,payer_total}/trade_type/bank_type/success_time) for the finalizer.
changes.ENTITLEMENT_SYNC: payCallback/lib/entitlementService.js aligned to verifyPayment's copy (adds challenge_unlock: challenge_records trialMode=false/unlocked=true). Copies now byte-identical.
changes.DB_INDEX_CHANGES: Created UNIQUE indexes: orders.orderId, payments.transactionId, entitlement_grants.orderId. Pre-checked: 0 duplicate orderId, 0 duplicate transactionId, 0 empty/null orderId → safe, no history mutation.
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/payment-finalizer.test.js (59 assertions): A happy, B dup verify, C dup callback, D concurrent race, E wrong amount, F wrong mchid, G wrong appid, H out_trade_no mismatch, I tx reuse, J unverified, K callback crypto, L settled idempotent + crash self-heal, M closed not reopened, N convergence/copy-integrity, O evidence unit.

rollbackPlan: git revert <this-commit>; drop the 3 unique indexes if needed (data-level rollback not required — no history mutated). No secret values committed.
